This WGT contains the complete Film2 Samsung Tizen TV player application but is unsigned.

Samsung TVs require every application to be signed with a valid Samsung/Tizen certificate profile before installation.
A physical TV distributor certificate is bound to the target TV DUID, so it cannot be generated safely in GitHub Actions without the owner's Samsung certificate material and target TV DUID.

Sign the source project at apps/tizen-tv-player with Tizen Studio or the Samsung Tizen TV VS Code extension using your Samsung author + distributor certificate profile. Do not edit a WGT after signing.
